Are you a test engineer with great interest in technology and products? Are you curious about software solutions, including network and devices? Now you have the opportunity to work as team test engineer in the product area Video Management Systems (VMS) at Axis HQ in Lund.
 
Who is your future team?
You will work at ACS Pro Test, which is responsible for testing Axis' proprietary VMS Axis Camera Station Pro. This Windows product is an important part of Axis' end-to-end solutions for video surveillance. You can find more information here: https://www.axis.com/products/axis-camera-station-pro
 
What you'll do here as a QA Engineer for Axis Camera Station Pro?
The development and testing of Axis Camera Station Pro is divided into several agile teams including both developers and testers. The team testing role we are about to fill is for a team that focuses on APIs and communication protocols.
 
Some of the responsibilities are:
* Plan and execute short term manual test needs based on new functionality together with the team
* Develop automated tests for the technical area 
* Participate in release testing for the complete solution
* Lead the work to set up and maintain good test environments for both automated and manual testing covering the team's needs
* Participate in improvement work related to working methods, test strategy, automation, and test environments
 
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for you who have experience in software testing and have good knowledge of agile development methods. We believe that you have a master's or bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent and have programming skills, preferably in Python and/or C#. You have previous experience of testing at different levels, manual and automated testing, functional and non-functional testing. You have experience of working with systems crossing the borders of software, hardware and network.
 
As a person, you are open, curious, structured and have a strong interest in both customer perspective and technology. You cooperate and communicate smoothly with others in both Swedish and English, you take initiative, and you have a good eye for details.
 
What Axis have to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. 
 
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.
 
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. 
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: 
Axis Career Hub 
Life at Axis blog  
Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
 
Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
 
We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!
If you have any questions, you are welcome to reach out to recruiting manager Pontus Nelderup at +46 46 272 1800.

IT ManagerShape the direction | Drive the change
Ready to take ownership of IT at SmartCella? Can you combine strategic thinking with hands-on expertise to solve challenges, shape our IT direction and turn ideas into practical improvements?
The opportunity
You will take operational responsibility for our application portfolio, information security and use of technology. Working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will establish processes and routines, manage incidents and oversee infrastructure to keep IT secure, reliable and cost-effective. The role combines broad ownership with practical problem-solving and the opportunity to drive IT-related improvements across the business. Reports to the CFO.
Where you’ll make an impact
Strategy & security
Take ownership of SmartCella’s IT architecture, solutions and technical environments.

Develop and maintain our IT and information security strategy, roadmap, policies and guidelines to meet business needs, legal standards and medical technology regulatory requirements.

Identify, assess and mitigate IT and information security risks.

Operations & partnerships
Manage day-to-day IT operations, including end-user support, incident management, technical support and maintenance of local applications.

Manage supplier relationships at strategic, tactical and operational levels.

Act as the main contact for external parties on IT and information security matters.

Business improvement & broader ownership
Advise the management team and wider business on IT matters, including new solutions, applications and platforms.

Lead IT-related business development projects and drive change.

What you bring
To succeed in this role, you bring:

An academic degree and at least five years of experience in a similar role, combining strategic and operational responsibilities within an international business.

Broad IT knowledge, including software lifecycle management, sourcing and implementation.

Up-to-date knowledge of market trends and technology developments.

Experience managing service agreements and procuring software and IT services.

Project management experience and familiarity with different project management methods.

Proven experience in IT operations or a similar role, including vendor management.

Solid knowledge of IT infrastructure components and hands-on experience in application and user support.

Fluency in both spoken and written Swedish and English.

Additional experience we value: Experience in biotech or life sciences, in a listed company or in an IT role within a regulated business is an advantage.
How you work
You are self-motivated, structured and analytical, with a collaborative, down-to-earth approach. You understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement and enjoy taking ownership of the IT function while rolling up your sleeves when needed. You translate business needs into technical requirements and explain technical topics in clear, accessible language.
Ready to make an impact?
Ready to take ownership and make an impact? We would love to hear from you. Submit your application today! We review applications on an ongoing basis and aim to fill the position as soon as possible.
he SmartCella group consist of SmartCella Holding AB, SmartWise Sweden AB and SmartCella Solutions AB with a total of 38 employees from 11 nationalities. We are a global drug delivery company pioneering innovative delivery solutions for targeted therapies, such as the Extroducer® (an endovascular delivery device that enables direct injection to hard-to-reach organs and tumors). We are an international and diverse team of scientists, visionary innovators, and experienced business leaders, dedicated to shaping the future of targeted therapies.

About the Job
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager in Information Technology domain with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience in managing complex IT projects, particularly within Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Digital Transformation.
The successful candidate will lead end-to-end technology projects, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of enterprise technology solutions. The position requires strong project management capabilities, technical understanding, leadership skills, and experience working in international business environments.
Job Responsibilities
·      Lead and manage IT projects from initiation to successful implementation and closure.
·      Define project scope, deliverables, budgets, schedules, resources, and milestones.
·      Manage projects involving Data Analytics, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, and AI solutions.
·      Coordinate AI, Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and automation initiatives.
·      Lead data migration, systems integration, cloud transformation, and technology modernization projects.
·      Manage Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies.
·      Coordinate cross-functional teams, including developers, data engineers, architects, business analysts, and external vendors.
·      Ensure effective risk management, project governance, quality assurance, and stakeholder communication.
·      Support enterprise data strategy, data governance, and GDPR compliance requirements.
·      Report project performance, delivery progress, and key risks to senior management.
·      Manage Service presale and proposal management
·      Manage customer requirements and expectations
Qualifications
Requirements
·      Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience in IT project management or technology delivery.
·      Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise IT projects.
·      Experience with Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or AI-related projects.
·      Strong understanding of enterprise IT systems, software development lifecycles, and systems integration.
·      Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project management methodologies.
·      Experience managing project budgets, resources, schedules, vendors, and stakeholders.
·      Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
·      Professional working proficiency in English.
Preferred Qualifications
·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
·      PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification.
·      Experience with cloud technologies such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
·      Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Python, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
·      Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, or intelligent automation.
·      Experience with enterprise data migration and digital transformation programs.
·      Understanding of GDPR, information security, and responsible AI.
·      Swedish language skills.
Personal Qualities
·      Strong leadership and organizational skills.
·      Structured and results-oriented approach to project delivery.
·      Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
·      Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
·      Ability to manage multiple priorities and complex projects.
·      Proactive, collaborative, and adaptable working style.
·      Ability to work independently and in multicultural teams.

About the Company
SilverByte AB operates within the Information Technology sector, focusing on technology solutions, digital transformation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence.
The company aims to deliver innovative, scalable, and business-oriented technology solutions to support organizational growth and operational efficiency.

Application
Please submit your updated CV and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience in IT project management, Data Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced ERP consultant and cross-functional process lead for a major business systems transformation. The organization has completed a current-state assessment and established a project organization to evaluate, procure, and introduce a new ERP solution.
The initiative includes a solution evaluation and procurement phase (Selection), followed by a verification and preparation phase (Discovery). During Discovery, the selected solution will be validated through a proof of concept (POC), while the project establishes the foundation for a robust implementation plan.
The ERP scope covers both financial and operational processes, including installation projects, service orders, and product sales. The Process Lead will play a central role in coordinating business workstreams, maintaining an end-to-end perspective, and establishing a consistent way of working throughout the Selection and Discovery phases.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and facilitate cross-functional forums throughout the Selection and Discovery phases.
Coordinate dependencies, handovers, and coherent end-to-end process flows across business workstreams.
Support business representatives in defining requirements based on use cases and business cases rather than existing processes or legacy system solutions.
Work with the Project Manager and ERP Architect to ensure that necessary decisions are documented and logged from an enterprise-wide perspective.
Ensure that business evaluation scenarios and demonstration scripts are complete and fit for purpose during Selection.
Coordinate and quality-assure business scenarios for the proof of concept during Discovery.
Maintain a cross-functional register of decisions, open questions, and risks together with the Project Manager and workstream leads.
Identify, describe, and present cross-functional challenges to the Project Manager and steering committee.
Provide project management guidance and support to business subproject managers and workstream owners.
Help establish the prerequisites for a structured, realistic, and robust ERP implementation plan.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Extensive experience with ERP selection, procurement, validation, and implementation initiatives.
Strong understanding of end-to-end business process design and cross-functional process dependencies.
Solid knowledge of order-to-cash processes.
Experience with project-oriented and service-oriented operational processes, including installation projects, service orders, and product sales.
Experience using a delivery model in which solution procurement is followed by structured validation and proof-of-concept activities.
Ability to translate business needs, use cases, and business cases into solution evaluation criteria and implementation requirements.
Experience maintaining decision, issue, dependency, and risk registers in complex transformation programs.

Qualifications & Experience
The successful consultant will have substantial experience from ERP transformation programs, preferably covering both solution procurement and implementation. The role requires broad business process understanding and the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining an end-to-end perspective.
The consultant should be an accomplished facilitator who combines a structured working method with a pragmatic approach. Experience supporting project managers, workstream leads, business representatives, architects, and steering committees in complex organizational environments is important. Professional proficiency in both Swedish and English is required.

Ready to make an impact at one of Sweden's fastest-growing companies?
At Najell, we empower the next generation of parents to live freely and do parenthood on their own terms. Through affordable premium products with smart, considered design, we combine style and functionality to make parenting look good. We believe there’s not one way to be a parent, and we’re here to inspire parents to do things their own way.
We're a fast-growing company where ideas turn into action, everyone is encouraged to take ownership, and every team member has the opportunity to make a real difference. Now we're looking for an HR Coordinator who wants to be a part of the journey.
The Role
Our HR team currently consists of an HR Manager and an HR Coordinator. As we continue to grow, we're looking for another HR Coordinator to strengthen our team and HR operations.
This is a hands-on and varied role where you'll combine day-to-day HR operations with opportunities to improve processes, take initiative and contribute to how we work.
Your responsibilities:

Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to managers.

Support compliance with employment legislation and health and safety requirements.

Coordinate HR administration across Scandinavia (and other markets as we grow).

Support and develop HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.

Manage payroll administration and related processes.

Support with recruitment and onboarding.

Managing statutory HR reporting.

Coordinate office management and helping create a great workplace.

The position is based at our office in central Lund and reports directly to the HR Manager. We believe great things happen when we work together, and that being on-site helps us collaborate, make quick decisions and move forward as a team. That's why this is a full-time, office-based role.
What we offer
At Najell, we set the pace. We're an ambitious and growing company where things move quickly and new ideas are encouraged.
We work closely across departments, help each other out and believe that good ideas can come from anyone.
As Najell grows, you'll have the opportunity to grow with us, develop your skills, take on new responsibilities and have a real influence on how we work.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who's ready to take the next step in their HR career. You enjoy a fast-moving environment, are comfortable with changing priorities and take initiative to find solutions.
You're structured and detail-oriented, while still seeing the bigger picture. You enjoy supporting others, improving processes and taking responsibility for your work.
We believe you have:

A relevant university degree in HR, law, business administration or a related field.

Knowledge of Swedish employment law and HR practices, gained through education or practical experience.

Preferably 1–3 years of relevant work experience.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a willingness to take ownership.

The ability to work independently while being a strong team player.

The ambition to grow, develop and make a meaningful contribution.

Application
Does this sound like your next opportunity?
Click Apply Here and upload your CV and cover letter. We'd love to hear more about you, what drives you and how you would contribute to Najell.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply.

REPORTS TO: Middle School Principal
Middle School Teacher for Science grades 6 through 9.
Our vision 
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers. 
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Duties/Responsibilities: 
Teaching of Grades 6-9 Science.
Contributing to the development and implementation of the Science curriculum.
Communicating regularly with parents. 
Be an active and contributing member of the School’s faculty. 
Participating in the full range of professional activities in the school. 
Actively contributing to the operational needs of the school. 
Fulfilling other assigned roles such as advisory and duties. 

Qualifications and Experience: 
Qualifications in the area of Middle School Science.
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Science.
At least 3 years of teaching experience in Science.
Preferred experience with IBMYP curriculum (Middle Years Programme).
Preferred additional qualifications in other academic disciplines. 
Excellent communication skills. 
The ability to establish a positive rapport with adults and students. 
The ability to work effectively in a team.
A pleasant and friendly personality. 
The ability to function effectively under pressure. 
The ability to show initiative and work independently. 

The successful applicant will preferably have a working knowledge of the IB Middle Years and/or Diploma Programmes. Experience working with students from diverse cultures and countries would be an advantage.

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer: As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation.

Contract: 
Temporary - fixed term (100%) 
Starting - January 7, 2027
End - June 15, 2027 
Salary
Fast lön/fixed salary (Salary scale)
Application
Last day for applications is November 20, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier).

Join Mpya Digital as a caring tech consultant on our new adventure!
Are you eager to have a greater impact on the performance, structure, and values of the company you work for? Do you find yourself tired of blending into the crowd? If so, we have an exciting opportunity awaiting you!
Welcome to Mpya Digital, a Stockholm-founded tech consultancy, now established in Skåne. We are a software development consultancy that values continuous learning and sharing culture to help you grow in your profession. We believe that nurturing our passions is what makes both us and our clients successful. 
Who we are
Founded in January 2018, Mpya Digital is today a team of 70+ tech enthusiasts – and growing. We consult some of the most cutting-edge technology companies around the world in their development of new products and features. We believe that nurturing our passions is what makes both us and our clients successful.
For most of us, our passions lie within the area of technology and development. But what makes us Mpya Digital is that we are not only passionate (really passionate!) about writing code, we are also passionate about people. We value continuous learning and a culture based on sharing to help you grow not only in your profession, but also as a human being.
What you will do
As a tech consultant, you will primarily work with software development, building high-quality solutions in modern tech stacks.
We believe great developers often grow beyond just coding over time. That’s why, together with you, we can shape your assignments to gradually include areas such as architecture, DevOps, cloud, or technical leadership, depending on your interests and ambitions.
You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge tech companies in Skåne (and possibly even in Stockholm) and collaborate with the full force of the Mpya Digital's organization behind you - your potential for impact knows no boundaries.
Since you will be one of the first consultants in this venture, you will also be able contribute to create a positive company culture and directly influence the growth of the company. You’d have to be courageous, caring and entrepreneurial.
Do you got what it takes? Perfect.
Qualifications
Fluent in English
University Degree or translatable work experience
4+ years of work experience related to software development
Based in the Malmö/Lund area
Previous experiences of being a consultant is meriting

Do you recognize yourself in the following?
Caring - You care about others, your client and the delivery, and are engaged in what you do.
Techy - You like problem-solving, and the tech industry is YOUR industry.
Better together - You believe that togetherness and inclusion are essential.

We offer the tools, education, courses, mentorship, and challenges so that you can become wiser more skilled version of yourself. We believe in distributed leadership which means that you are a decision-maker and a leader. We also offer a unique salary model where you will self-assess your work and together with your crew decide your and your colleagues' salaries.
Life is too short to work at a place that doesn’t bring you joy!
Joyn us!

Do you want to join a global leader and make a real difference in the energy transition? As a Product Specialist in our Rock Drilling Tools division, you will play a vital role in supporting continuous product development and ensuring technical excellence for our top hammer solutions across the globe.
 
This is an opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment where your expertise will directly influence product performance and customer satisfaction—and help shape the future of the mining and construction industry.
Join us as we accelerate the transformation!
 
Join our team
At Epiroc, it all starts with people. People like you. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team committed to innovation and customer success. Our mission is to deliver world-class drilling solutions and ensure our customers achieve the highest productivity and safety standards. In this role, you will report to the Global Product Support Manager in the Top Hammer Solutions Business Line and work closely with R&D, Product Management, Customer Centers, and end users.
 
Your mission
As Product Specialist, you will be hands-on in field activities acting as a trusted technical partner. You will be supporting product portfolio development and strengthen technical competence across the organization.
 
Key responsibilities include:
Providing technical support for internal teams and second-line support for customers and sales channels
Participating in field tests and proof-of-concept activities
Maintaining and developing a product performance database, collecting and analyzing performance data
Delivering technical training and creating training materials
Collaborating on new product releases and marketing materials
Frequent global travel to customer sites for field support and training

 
Your profile
To thrive in this role, you should have a strong technical background in drilling, mining, or construction equipment, combined with excellent communication skills and a proactive, customer-focused mindset. You enjoy collaborating and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.
 
Qualifications:
Technical, marketing, or business education with relevant industry knowledge.
Minimum 5 years of experience in technical or application support within relevant field.
Skilled in data analysis and reporting, with proficiency in MS Office.
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (written and spoken).
Willingness to travel globally and ability to work independently while collaborating across teams.
Knowledge of Epiroc drilling equipment and operating procedures for drill rigs is an advantage.

 
With us, you will have the chance to grow professionally and personally while contributing to the success of an industry leader. Join us as we accelerate the transformation!
 
Location and other
This position is located in Fagersta, Sweden. Travel is required by approximately 70-80 days per year.

Application and contact information
We encourage you to submit your application  as soon as possible, but no later than November 20, 2026. 
 
We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.
 
For questions about the position, please contact: Recruitment Specialist: Diana Novakovicova

jobs.occupation: Telecom Data Scientist | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity    Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI  contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. 
  
 This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
      What you will do   You will join a dynamic and international environment where you’ll have the opportunity to learn, grow and make a real business impact. As part of the Applied Generative AI team, you will use data science, machine learning and generative AI to help transform Ericsson R&D from a development flow organized in separate disciplines into a connected, data-driven and AI-native way of working. You will:
  Translate Radio Access Network (RAN) and product-development challenges into data science and AI problems, define success measures, and evaluate results with engineering and domain teams.
 Make engineering information, including specifications, architecture, code, tests, logs and operational reports, useful and trustworthy for AI.
 Build data pipelines, knowledge systems and retrieval capabilities that connect engineering information in different formats.
 Experiment with and evaluate machine learning and generative AI, including large language models and AI-agent systems.
 Connect code, system knowledge and operational evidence to support work throughout development, verification, deployment, operation and troubleshooting.
 Help develop and assess AI models for Ericsson technologies and terminology with RAN specialists and users.
 Turn successful experiments into maintainable engineering capabilities, with attention to data quality, security, responsible AI, monitoring and human review.
  
 
 You will bringYou are curious and pragmatic, take initiative, ask questions and work well across disciplines. You combine a strong foundation in data science, machine learning and generative AI with knowledge of telecommunications or radio networks, and want to apply it to real product-development challenges. Experience in software or product development is an advantage.
  
 In addition, you have:
  MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, AI, machine learning, telecommunications, electrical or software engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
 Applied data science and machine-learning skills, including statistics, experimentation, model development and evaluation.
 Practical generative-AI experience in one or more areas such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model adaptation, AI agents or model evaluation.
 Knowledge of wireless communications or radio networks, and interest in building deeper RAN expertise.
 Hands-on programming and software-development experience, including work with complex data and reproducible analyses, models or pipelines.
 An understanding of how product development connects requirements, architecture, implementation, verification, release and maintenance.
 Analytical judgement, an experimental mindset, and the ability to explain uncertainty, model limitations and technical trade-offs.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, proficiency in English, and readiness to work in global, cross-functional teams.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer - ATLAS ITk Pixel Detector
jobs.description:
What you'll do
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing.

As a mechanical engineer in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment on the design, construction and installation of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer System.

Your responsibilities
-Design of precision tooling for the integration, testing and installation of the ITk Pixel Outer System Detector, comprising the Outer Barrel, Endcaps and Inner System Support Tube.
-Design and develop service installation procedures and tooling, including temporary service management solutions for testing of the ITk Pixel Detector.
-Verify the design of components and tooling according to the relevant standards and best engineering practices, performing both, analytical and numerical calculations.
-Develop, document and implement tools and procedures for integration and installation of detector components and services.
-Participate hands-on in the detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom as well as the preparation on surface and in the cavern for the installation.
-Prepare technical specifications for components and tools, following up their production, acceptance and installation.
-Support preparation of and participate in the ATLAS ID detector extraction.

Your profile
-Proven experience in the design of precision mechanical components and assembly tools for complex systems.
-Demonstrated experience in the use of CAD software for 3D modelling and management of large assemblies. Proficiency in Catia V5 would be a plus.
-Demonstrated experience in the production of 2D technical drawings according to the relevant standards for dimensioning and tolerances (e.g. ISO Geometrical Product Specifications, GPS).
-Proven hands-on experience in the construction and testing of mechanical systems.
-Demonstrated experience drafting technical specifications, assembly procedures and engineering reports.
-Experience with assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.
-Experience with structural joining techniques, particularly orbital welding is advantageous.
-Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
-Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
-Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).
-Integration of mechanical systems.
-Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.
-Knowledge and application of joining techniques, welding.
-Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
-Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements, adopting a pragmatic approach. Understands the value of adopting generic rather than 'gold -plated' technical solutions.
-Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships, but also works well autonomously. Takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role
As a Data Solutions Engineer, you will work with complex vehicle data and build reliable data flows that turn fragmented information into structured, high-quality data for our diagnostic products. You will work across the entire data flow, from ingestion and transformation to validation and delivery, with a strong focus on data quality, automation and scalable solutions.
You will play an important role in developing and maintaining the data pipelines that form the foundation of our diagnostic products. This position combines hands-on development with problem-solving and continuous improvement and you will work independently on technical solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, data developers and other teams across the organization.
Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.

Working with data ingestion, transformation, validation and delivery.

Ensuring data quality through automated testing and monitoring.

Identifying and resolving data errors, anomalies and pipeline issues.

Automating manual and repetitive data management processes.

Contributing to data modelling and cloud-based data solutions.

Translating technical requirements and vehicle protocols into reliable and useful datasets together with software developers, data developers and other stakeholders.

What you bring
We are looking for someone with solid experience in software development, data engineering or data solutions, who is comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation. You enjoy working hands-on and solving technical problems, while also being able to step back, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute your own ideas on technical solutions and ways of working.
A relevant university degree is an advantage, but your professional experience will be the most important factor.
We believe you have:

Solid experience in programming and software development, for example Python.

Experience working with data management, data transformation and/or data pipelines.

Experience working with structured data such as XML, JSON and APIs.

The ability to independently drive technical solutions and take ownership of your work.

Good Swedish and English skills, both spoken and written.

As a person, you are self-motivated, proactive and communicative. You take ownership and enjoy driving things forward, while contributing your own ideas on how technical solutions and processes can be improved. You work in a structured and quality-focused way and enjoy collaborating with people with different areas of expertise.
Application
In this recruitment process, Autocom is collaborating with Skill. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

ALTEN is seeking an engaged Embedded Developer to join our team in Sweden. You will work with a leading client in the Automotive industry, focusing on Driver Interaction systems in a hybrid setup. In this role, you will take ownership of the development process from start to finish: understanding user needs, implementing solutions, and ensuring quality in an Agile team environment.

What do we offer

A chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative projects

A dynamic and collaborative work environment

Opportunities for professional growth and career development

A role where you can make a real impact in the Automotive industry

You will be part of a team developing Driver Interaction systems, focusing on how drivers interact with the vehicle through displays, stalks, and switches. Your work will primarily involve Embedded C for core logic and C++/Qt for HMI visualization. The developed code will be integrated into the Instrument Cluster (Driver Information Module), which runs on a dual-processor architecture—one for AUTOSAR and another for Linux/Yocto with Qt.

You will collaborate in a Scrum team of around 6 people, including a dedicated Product Owner and Scrum Master. The team emphasizes continuous integration and automated regression testing, ensuring high-quality deliverables. Communication protocols like CAN, LIN, and Ethernet (SOME/IP, STOMP, display sharing) will be part of your daily work.

Your main responsibilities

Develop Embedded C code for core logic in Driver Interaction systems

Implement HMI visualization using C++/Qt

Work with AUTOSAR and ensure compliance with ISO 26262 requirements

Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum team to define and realize driver interaction features

Integrate and test software on a dual-processor architecture (AUTOSAR + Linux/Yocto)

Utilize communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet (SOME/IP, STOMP)

Participate in continuous integration and automated regression testing

Your profile

We are looking for a fast-learning, curious, and team-oriented developer with a strong background in Embedded C, AUTOSAR, and ISO 26262.

Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field

Proven experience in Embedded C development

Hands-on experience with AUTOSAR and ISO 26262 implementation

Experience with HMI development and driver interaction systems

Familiarity with C++/Qt for visualization

Fluent in English (Swedish is a plus)

About ALTEN

ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

For the sixth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

Survey Technician / Survey Engineer – Precisiona AB
Would you like to join a growing company where quality, responsibility, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do?
Precisiona AB is looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Survey Technician / Survey Engineer to join our team. We work on a wide range of construction and civil engineering projects and are seeking a professional who can contribute technical expertise, commitment, and strong problem-solving skills.
About the Position
As a Survey Technician / Survey Engineer at Precisiona AB, you will be responsible for setting out, surveying, quantity calculations, verification measurements, and technical documentation within construction and civil engineering projects.
You will work both independently and in close collaboration with project managers, contractors, and other professionals to ensure accuracy and quality throughout the various stages of each project.
Our projects are primarily based in the Stockholm area, but assignments may also take place in other locations throughout Sweden. Therefore, candidates must be flexible and willing and able to work outside Stockholm when required.
Requirements
We are looking for candidates who have:
Previous experience as a Survey Technician or Survey Engineer within the construction or civil engineering industry.

Relevant technical education, such as a degree in Civil Engineering, Surveying, Geomatics, or a vocational qualification in surveying or geodesy.

Good understanding of construction processes and the ability to interpret technical drawings.

Experience with modern surveying instruments and related software.

A valid Category B driving licence.

Good communication skills in Swedish or English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications
The following qualifications are considered an advantage:
Experience working on infrastructure and large-scale civil engineering projects.

Knowledge of CAD, BIM, SBG Geo, MS Office, and AMA (Swedish construction specifications).

Experience with GNSS, total stations, and laser scanning, preferably using Leica or Trimble equipment.

Experience with quantity surveying, measurement-based quantity verification, and machine control systems.

Personal Qualities
We place great importance on personal qualities. To succeed in this role, we believe you are:
Responsible and independent – able to manage your tasks effectively and take ownership of your work.

Detail-oriented and organised – committed to accuracy, precision, and high-quality results.

Solution-focused – capable of identifying challenges and developing practical solutions.

Communicative and team-oriented – comfortable collaborating with professionals from different disciplines.

Flexible and adaptable – willing to work across different projects, environments, and locations.

What We Offer
At Precisiona AB, you will have the opportunity to become part of a dedicated team within a growing company. We offer:
Diverse and challenging construction and civil engineering projects.

A collaborative working environment built on responsibility, professionalism, and technical expertise.

Opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility.

Competitive employment terms and conditions.

Opportunities to work on a variety of projects across Sweden.

How to Apply
Does this opportunity sound right for you?
Send your CV and a brief introduction about yourself to info@precisiona.se, using "Survey Technician" as the email subject line.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to Precisiona AB!

jobs.occupation: General nurses wanted for permanent positions in Norway
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified general nurse looking for professional growth and new life experiences?
We offer numerous exciting opportunities for nurses who are interested in moving to Norway, a country known for its high-quality healthcare system, balanced work-life culture and beautiful natural landscapes.
Your role:
Providing holistic care to patients, addressing their medical, hygienic and social needs.
Monitoring patients’ vital signs and keeping records of their health progress.
Administering medications and treatments as prescribed by doctors.
Performing blood draws and other routine medical procedures.
Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver optimal care.
Offering emotional support and clear communication to patients and their families.
Working in both hospital and home care settings, adapting to each patient’s individual needs.

Qualifications:
Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU country.
Have previous work experience as a nurse, with a preference for those who have experience in hospitals or community care settings.
Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments.
Speak and write English fluently. Candidates must also be motivated to learn Norwegian.
Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN).
A driver’s license may be required for certain home care positions.

Personal qualities:
Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.
A responsible, structured, and flexible approach to patient care.
The ability to remain calm and perform under pressure, handling stressful situations with a professional attitude.
Respect for patients’ individual needs and a compassionate approach to their care.
A strong desire to move to Norway and integrate into Norwegian society, bringing your family along for a rewarding experience.
A genuine passion for nursing, combined with a clear understanding of your professional responsibilities and limitations.
The ability to prioritize tasks and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.

What we offer:
Competitive salary packages and pension plans.
A permanent employment opportunity in a supportive and friendly environment.
A clear path for professional growth and development.
Free online Norwegian language courses with a private tutor to ease your transition.
Full assistance with obtaining Norwegian nursing authorization.
Comprehensive support with relocation logistics, including help with accommodation, schools, and childcare for your family.
Guidance from professional headhunters with 19 years of experience, who will assist you throughout the entire process.

Why choose Norway?
Norway is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world for quality of life. Our healthcare system is publicly funded, providing patients with excellent care while offering healthcare professionals a structured and rewarding work environment. 
Nurses in Norway benefit from clear career progression, strong support from interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to spend quality time with each patient, contributing to better health outcomes. In addition to professional growth, moving to Norway offers a chance to experience a high standard of living, with clean air, a focus on outdoor activities and a family-friendly environment.
If you see yourself thriving in this role and want to explore the possibilities of working in Norway, we encourage you to contact us. We look forward to guiding you through the next steps in your journey!
